overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-allocation performance, and establishing a fixed-point physics accumulator for endgame stability.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a 64-bit FNV-1a hash accumulator for simulation state. Use constexpr where possible. No dynamic allocation. Hash struct members in declaration order. Provide a static inline function for combining hashes. Ensure endianness consistency via std::endian::native checks. Max 40 lines.
acceptance_criteria: Hash value is identical across 1000 Monte Carlo runs for identical state.
Zero heap allocations during hash computation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Guarantees save/load consistency, preventing desyncs in long-running simulations.

tasks.title: Fixed-Point Physics Accumulator for Endgame Stability
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a struct FixedPointAccumulator using int64_t for position and velocity. Implement step() with a fixed delta time (1/60s). Use integer arithmetic for all operations. No floating-point types. Include a reset() method. Max 50 lines.
acceptance_criteria: Position and velocity remain stable after 10,000 steps.
No floating-point drift observed in 1000-step test.
All operations are constexpr-compatible where applicable.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Eliminates floating-point drift in long simulations, ensuring precise object placement.

tasks.title: Zero-Alloc Colonist Psychology State Machine
tasks.architectural_spec: Create a union-based state machine for colonist moods (Idle, Working, Resting, Panicked). Use std::variant with fixed-size alternatives. Implement transition() with switch-case. No heap allocation. Max 60 lines.
acceptance_criteria: State transitions occur in O(1) time.
Memory footprint is exactly 16 bytes per colonist.
No dynamic memory allocation during state changes.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Improves simulation performance and reduces memory usage for large colonist counts.
